messages:
June W.: flag from usability: when people drill into a project the invoice CTA disappears below the fold. asking for a persistent affordance that doesn't bloat the header.

Rory (PM): we tried header CTAs and floating FABs before. new idea: a sticky bottom summary bar that contains totals + primary actions (Invoice PDF, Export CSV). keeps header compact and CTAs visible.

Tess (Design): sketched a bottom bar: small, 56px height, left: condensed totals, center: scope chip, right: two buttons (PDF/CSV). mock: https://redwood.design/sketches/sticky-summary-bar

Arjun: love the summary bar for mobile. for desktop it could be optional (collapsed). but ensure it doesn't overlap native UI or blockers. z-index and safe-area inset should be respected.

Nina QA: if we go sticky bottom, ensure keyboard users can reach it after tabbing through content. also test VoiceOver/NVDA reading order so screen readers don't miss actions.

accessibility-bot: checklist: actions must have aria-labels with scope, e.g., "Download invoices for Project: Phoenix (PDF)"; buttons must be in DOM order consistent with visual order.

Tess (Design): microcopy: "Download invoices (PDF)" and "Export usage (CSV)". PDF button primary, CSV secondary. include small help tooltip: "Invoices include monthly PDF summaries; CSV includes per-line usage."

June W.: product question: when user switches scope from org -> project, do we pre-filter the invoice contents or include both? users expect scoped downloads to match current view.

Rory (PM): downloads should respect current filters (scope/timeframe). also add a small toast confirming filename and link. filename pattern: <org>[-<project>]_YYYY-MM-DD_{pdf|csv}.

Arjun: telemetry: download_initiated (scope, timeframe, format), download_success, download_failure. also track discovery metrics: percent_of_sessions_with_sticky_bar_visible.

Nina QA: bug found in prototype: when chart is scrolled to top, the sticky bar covers the last row of the table. add margin-bottom to page content when sticky is present.

Tess (Design): updated mock includes page-padding-bottom and accessible focus styles. also added an opt-in "pin invoice" control: users can pin last-downloaded invoice to quick-access list in the header for repeated reference.

June W.: pin invoice feature is nice for finance teams who repeatedly download the same report. product ok to scope as MVP flag.

Rory (PM): experiment plan: Group A = sticky bottom bar + compact token chips; Group B = header CTA + expanded bubble chart. measure download rate, time-to-download, and support tickets mentioning "can't find invoice".

accessibility-bot: also recommend filename spoken text for screen readers: include parentheses, e.g., "Invoice for Acme Corp (project Phoenix) dated 2026-03-01".

Arjun: impl notes: use position:fixed with prefers-reduced-motion false; respect prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-reduced-transparency. fallback for legacy browsers: show header CTA.

Nina QA: will write test cases for keyboard nav, screen reader flow, small viewport visual regressions.

Tess (Design): I'll update Figma, add the pinned-invoices microflow and the tooltip copy. tagging @eng-frontend for handoff.

June W.: timeline: aim for prototype next sprint; roll experiment the following sprint. closing thread when designs + RFC PR are linked.
